images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exquisitely designed, high-fidelity desktop web app screenshot for ApplyFlow, landscape 1536x1024, straight-on flat screen no device frame, entirely English interface, crisp readable typesetting. This is a working AI resume and cover letter tailoring tool, NOT a marketing page or tracking dashboard.
Visual material is essential: warm daylight frosted glass with dark ink typography appearing printed directly on luminous translucent glass. Atmospheric softly blurred background mixing pale apricot/peach, dusty rose, champagne and pale sage green, large blurred colored light fields visible THROUGH neutral white translucent panels. No blue, cyan, saturated violet, black background or dark mode. Glass itself is neutral white translucent, never solid colored cards. Generous white specular hairline along upper-left edge, subtle refraction at rounded edges, soft diffused shadows, glass blur loses details but preserves pastel color. Sophisticated experimental gallery/editorial art direction, tactile macOS-like material, not generic SaaS. A faint broad out-of-focus light ribbon can cross backdrop. Strong dark charcoal text contrast; readable darker secondary text, no ghostly pale text. One main floating frosted surface, restrained layering, no nested card grid. Modern minimal sans-serif typography, precise spacing, large margins, restrained expressive headline. Do not fill whitespace with decorations, metrics or extraneous features.
Shared slim top bar with ApplyFlow wordmark at left, 'Create' and 'My applications' center, 'Alex' with tiny dropdown right. No sidebar. Dark warm olive solid primary buttons, translucent secondary controls, thin stroke icons without colored icon containers. Tiny bottom footer 'Design concept · Sample content'. This is a coherent product family.
SCREEN 1: The main creation entrance. Page headline centered above panel 'Your next role. Your best story.' with short subtitle 'Turn a job description into a tailored resume and cover letter.'
A wide luminous frosted-glass composer centered on page, width about 940px, plenty of air around it. Small label 'Job description'. Inside one large open writing/drop surface show exact placeholder 'Paste a job description or job link...' and second quieter line 'Or drop a screenshot here'. A small secondary 'Upload screenshot' action anchored inside lower left of surface; simple image icon. These are alternative inputs, not three separate forms.
Below a fine divider, one compact attached resume row: file icon, 'Alex_Morgan_Resume.pdf', supporting 'Your base resume', and 'Change' at right. Below that brief note 'We use your resume and profile to tailor your documents.'
Bottom action row: small unobtrusive 'AI connection ready' at left and a single primary pill 'Create my drafts' with subtle arrow at right.
Very small below panel 'Review the extracted job details before generation.' No charts, no project tiles, no progress tracker, no three-step giant boxes. The screenshot should instantly communicate screenshot/text/link plus user's existing resume = tailored application documents. Give this entrance the strongest luminous glass material and watercolor-like diffused pastel light, while type stays razor sharp.

SCREEN 2: Resume draft review workspace, same background and header. Compact title above a single wide glass work surface 'Make your experience relevant.' Subline 'Backend Engineer · Northstar'. Small quiet 'Job details' action nearby.
Inside main glass surface a header row with 'Resume' active tab and 'Cover letter' inactive tab, 'Draft saved' small status, right primary button 'Export resume'.
Main work area is a generous document preview on the left two-thirds and one narrow refinement column right one-third separated by a fine vertical rule, not multiple cards. The resume has a slightly milkier translucent glass reading surface, NOT an opaque paper card; dark perfectly readable text. Document content 'ALEX MORGAN', 'Backend Engineer', 'SUMMARY', 'Backend engineer building reliable services with Go and PostgreSQL.', 'EXPERIENCE', 'Software Engineer · Fieldwork', 'Built Go APIs backed by PostgreSQL for internal workflows.', 'Improved service reliability through clearer error handling and integration tests.', 'SKILLS', 'Go · PostgreSQL · REST APIs · Git'. Use professionally spaced actual short text, no lorem ipsum.
Right column title 'What changed' with two understated items 'Focused your summary on backend services' and 'Reordered skills to match the role'. Lower down a gentle warm neutral callout 'Needs your input' and 'The role mentions Redis. Add it only if you have used it.' Link 'Add experience'. Small note 'Your original resume stays unchanged.'
At the base of right column a simple refinement input with placeholder 'Ask for a change...' and compact arrow action. Small link 'Compare with original'. Keep all legible, minimal, no match percentages, scores, charts, fabricated achievements, chat transcript, extra dashboard widgets. Pastel peach and sage diffusion visibly filters through glass in margins.

SCREEN 3: Cover letter review workspace, visually same product as screen2. Compact title above main glass surface 'A letter that sounds like you.' Subline 'Backend Engineer · Northstar'.
Main single wide luminous frosted surface header has 'Resume' inactive tab and 'Cover letter' active tab, small 'Draft saved', primary dark olive pill 'Export cover letter' right.
Large left two-thirds is the editable letter directly on milky frosted glass, ample typographic spacing, dark charcoal ink. No paper sheet frame or opaque white rectangle. Text: 'Dear Northstar team,' then three short paragraphs:
'I am applying for the Backend Engineer role at Northstar. My experience building services with Go and PostgreSQL aligns with the core requirements of the position.'
'At Fieldwork, I built backend APIs and improved service reliability through integration tests and clearer error handling. I would welcome the opportunity to bring that practical approach to your team.'
'I would love to discuss how my experience could contribute to this role. Thank you for your time and consideration.'
'Sincerely,' and 'Alex Morgan'. Tiny below letter 'Based on your resume and the job description'.
Right one-third separated only by thin vertical line. Heading 'Make it yours'. A tidy 'Tone' segmented control 'Natural' selected, 'Formal' alternative. Label 'Length' with 'Concise' selected and 'Standard' alternative. Small textarea label 'Anything to add?' placeholder 'Why this company, a project, or a personal connection...'. Secondary button 'Update draft'. Quiet note 'Review before sending.' Keep right column spare, no multiple glass cards. Lower footer of workspace understated 'Save to my applications' link. No sending button, no fake success, no big statistics. Background glass luminosity and peach rose sage blended light remain gently visible, with generous clear reading zones.
